artworks.title: Title Page for Stephanus Simonini, Silvae Urbaninae
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a classical allegorical scene with two figures, a coat of arms, and an inscription. The central image features an ornate coat of arms with three bees on a shield, topped with a papal tiara and keys, surrounded by decorative foliage. Below the coat of arms, there is an inscription on a stone mentioning Stephan Simonini and urban affairs (Silvae Urbanianae seu Gesta Urbani VIII). Flanking the inscription are two figures in classical attire: one standing and reaching towards the inscription, the other sitting on a volute with an urn. The background includes trees and a distant landscape. The drawing showcases intricate cross-hatching and light and shadow effects, characteristic of engravings from that era.

artworks.title: Title Page for Philomathi Musae Juveniles
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: The image features two figures seated on a rock. Both figures are shown from the waist up, facing forward but slightly turned towards each other. The figure on the left has curly hair and wears a laurel wreath. This figure's facial features are classical and idealized. He is holding a lyre and a quiver with arrows is visible over his shoulder. The figure on the right wears a winged hat and has angular features. He is holding a staff with snakes, known as a caduceus. Both figures are draped in cloths. In the background, there is a large tree with a crest or coat of arms on its trunk. The image is etched in a classical antiquity style.

artworks.title: Title Page for M.C. Sarbievski, Lyricorum Libri IV
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a classical style next to a pedestal with a lyre on top. One figure on the left is standing with curly hair and draped clothing, while the figure on the right also has curly hair with a laurel wreath and similar clothing. There is a water source at the base of the pedestal, and a small, bundled infant in a basket-like structure near the right figure’s feet. The background has stylized trees and a classical landscape. Above the lyre on the pedestal is an ornate design with floral elements, keys, and a papal tiara surrounding a blank oval medallion.

artworks.title: Title Page for Silvester Pietrasanta, De Symbolis Heroicis
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of classical figures surrounding a central text. The image shows two winged figures with flowing robes and curled hair, with one holding a caduceus and a torch over a flaming urn. The figures flank an inscription that likely represents a book or manuscript title. Below them, cherubic figures with wings are depicted on the base. The background includes swirling clouds emanating from the center. The intricate hatching and line work suggest it is an engraving or etching typical of detailed printmaking that features classical and baroque elements.

artworks.title: Title Page for Silvester Pietrasanta, De Symbolis Heroicis
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is an image of an allegorical scene with classical figures. The artwork depicts three figures in an illustrative, allegorical style often associated with classical mythology. The central figure is an angelic or divine figure with wings, holding bound arrows and an ornate emblem with a serpent-wrapped staff, surrounded by foliage. On the left, a male figure holds tools or a bundle of objects. On the right stands a female figure adorned with a floral crown and draped clothing. Below them is a plinth or pedestal bearing inscriptions, flanked by two cherubic figures with wings. The drawing showcases musculature and classical poses, emphasized by strong contrasts of light and shadow, giving depth to the artwork.

artworks.title: Hoc Tanta Moles Nititvr...
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate structure with a coat of arms and intricate architectural elements. The design features a symmetrical composition with a pyramid-like structure at its center adorned with multiple heraldic shields. At the top is an emblem with wings and two decorative floral motifs. In the center, there is a figure at the base of the structure that appears to be a classical statue or iconographic figure draped in robes, standing in a niche between two intricately carved columns. Below is a Latin inscription. The columns are richly decorated with classical designs resembling Corinthian pillars, adding grandeur to the composition. The overall piece conveys formality and reverence, possibly indicating a ceremonial or commemorative object.

artworks.title: Title Page for Carolus Scribani, Politico-Christianus
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length depictions of figures, one on the left and one on the right, surrounding a central ornate cartouche. The left figure is standing, holding a staff or spear, and is dressed in flowing robes. This figure has a halo around its head, with curly hair cascading to the shoulders. On the right, another standing figure is clad in flowing attire, holding a horn of plenty overflowing with fruits. This figure also has curly hair and is looking towards the central inscription. Between and above them is a winged cherubic figure coming out from clouds, holding a scepter and a crown. At the feet of the central inscription, a smaller cherubic figure is seen holding a hammer. The background is filled with clouds and rays of light emanating from the halo on the left.

artworks.title: Title Page for Imperatorvm Romanorvm Nvmismata Avrea
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical figure sitting beside an ornamental shield with an inscription. The figure is classically draped, holding scales in one hand, and there is a cornucopia of flowers beside them. The background includes an archway with brickwork and foliage. The ornamental shield is inscribed with text in Latin. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatching techniques to indicate texture and depth.

artworks.title: Title Page for Jean Boyvin, Le Siege de la Ville de Dole
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Erasmus Quellinus II after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a seated bearded man in regal clothing, wearing a crown. He is holding a scepter and is interacting with an allegorical female figure standing in front of him. Another figure is depicted to the side. The background includes a textured surface, a banner with the word "FIDES," and an ornate shield with a crown and an inscription about the siege and liberation of Dole in France. Musical instruments and objects like a trumpet and a scroll are intertwined around the shield, and a small dog is at the feet of the figures.

artworks.title: Title Page for Apostolicarvm PII Qvinti Pont. Max...
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page featuring classical figures and elaborate details. The central focus is a decorative oval frame with text surrounded by two putti on the left and right. Above the text is a portrait of a bearded sage in a laurel wreath, flanked by angelic figures. Intricate scrollwork and classical decorative motifs embellish the surroundings, with mythological elements and symbols. Below the main title scroll is a relief scene depicting maritime imagery. The composition emphasizes a Baroque aesthetic.

artworks.title: Vignette for a Book Dedicated to Pope Urban VII
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic scene with religious figures. The image features a central coat of arms flanked by two figures, each holding a symbolic item, and adorned with ornate decorative elements. The figures stand on either side of an elaborate central emblem, which is topped by a crown-like structure and two crossed keys. The figures are clad in long robes and are barefoot. Around the emblem are cherubic faces with wings. On either side of the composition, there are intricate floral and fruit garlands. The drawing is intricately detailed with bold lines and hatching.

artworks.title: Printer's Device for Jan van Keerbergen: Vignette for Biblia Cum Glossa Ordinaria
artworks.artist: Hans Collaert the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central circular medallion adorned with a globe, clouds, rays of light, a head of a classical figure, two cornucopias overflowing with fruits, vegetables, and flowers, stylized wings at the top, and scrolls tied with ribbons on the sides. The framework around the medallion is detailed and ornate, creating a sense of grandeur and abundance.

artworks.title: Vignette for the Title Page of Martinus Bonacina, Opera Omnia
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a symmetrical arrangement with classical themes and imagery. The composition includes an ornate oval frame at the center containing a scene of a hen on a nest, flanked by two busts in profile with winged helmets. Above the central scene are an owl on the left, a vessel with a ribbon reading "NOCTE INCUBANDO" in the center, and a rooster on a helmet on the right. The bottom portion includes crossed musical instruments and a caduceus beneath framing ribbons. The style resembles emblematic and allegorical designs from the Renaissance or Baroque periods, featuring intricate linework and shading.

artworks.title: Vignette for the Title Page of C. Peregrino, Principes Hollandiae et Zelandiae
artworks.artist: Christoffel Jegher after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring animals and helmets arranged in a symbolic composition. In the center, there's a medallion with a hen on a nest above crossed staffs. On either side are helmeted profiles with banners above them; to the left, it reads “NOCTV” with an owl, and to the right, “DIVOYE” with a crowing cock. Above the medallion is a flaming lamp with the word “INCVBANDO” on a ribbon. The style is detailed with engravings and intricate line work reminiscent of classical and renaissance art.

artworks.title: Vignette for Title Page of Balthasar Cordier, Catena Patrum Graecorum in Sanctum Ioannem
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate heraldic crest. The image features a coat of arms with two bird-like creatures flanking a shield topped with a crown. The shield displays various heraldic symbols, including a pattern of alternating colors, lions, and other traditional elements. Surrounding the shield are decorative elements such as laurels, floral designs, and cornucopias. Above the shield is a star or sun burst. The composition is symmetrical and detailed, conveying a sense of regality and artistry.

artworks.title: Printer's Device for the Plantin Press
artworks.artist: Christoffel Jegher after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: woodcut in red on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical style emblem or crest. The drawing features a central circular medallion depicting a figure framed by an ornate border. The surrounding design incorporates classical architectural elements and decorative motifs, including ornamental scrolls and floral accents. Two robed figures stand on either side of the central medallion, adding a sense of symmetry and balance to the composition. The artwork has a delicate and detailed linework, executed in a reddish tint.

artworks.title: Franz Rose in His Study
artworks.artist: Albert Welti
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated on a sofa or chair. He has his legs crossed and a blanket draped over them. The man is holding a pipe in his right hand and is dressed in a formal military-style jacket. He has a mustache and neat, combed-back hair. Beside him is an ornate lamp on a stack of books, with more books visible on the right. The background features a densely textured wall with books or wooden panels.

artworks.title: Bedouin Women
artworks.artist: John Singer Sargent
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in draped garments covering their entire bodies, including their heads. Both figures are standing, with one figure having arms down and the other with an arm raised near the face area, holding onto the garment. The facial features and hair are not visible due to the coverage of the draped fabric. The fabric is flowing and gathered, creating a draping effect. There are no visible jewelry or objects aside from the fabric. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Study of Ezekiel for "Frieze of Prophets"
artworks.artist: John Singer Sargent
artworks.medium: charcoal and white chalk on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a standing person with flowing garments covering their body. The person's face is partially hidden by fabric or a hood, with the features not clearly defined. The clothing is large and flowing, creating a sense of movement and depth with light and shadow. There are no visible accessories or objects, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Study for "The Crucifixion and Death of Our Lord"
artworks.artist: John Singer Sargent
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image features a rough sketch of a person's upper body, from the shoulders up. The person appears to be sitting or leaning slightly forward. The facial features are implied with some shading around the eye area and a hint of a nose. The hair is sketched abstractly, showing a short hairstyle. The clothing is suggested by broad strokes around the shoulders, possibly a cloak or blanket. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with the main focus on the sketched figure.

artworks.title: Study for "Hell"
artworks.artist: John Singer Sargent
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Quai de l'Hôtel de Ville
artworks.artist: Auguste Lepère
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on tissue paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Eric Denker in memory of Gaillard F. Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view across a wide expanse towards a large building, possibly a cathedral. The horizon sits just below the buildings. Architectural elements are detailed with intricate linework, capturing the texture and form of the structures. The color palette is subdued and monochromatic, using shades of grey and sepia to convey a wintry mood, with a dusting of snow. People are shown walking along a snow-covered street in the foreground. In the distance, the building dominates the skyline. Soft clouds are visible in the lightly rendered sky.

artworks.title: Henri de Bourbon, Roi de Navarre
artworks.artist: Simon Charles Miger after François-André Vincent
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on China paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.6 x 14.6 cm (8 1/2 x 5 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a detailed black and white engraving showing a half-length portrait of a man. The portrait is encased within an ornate oval frame adorned with leaves and intricate patterns. The man is seated and turned slightly to his right, gazing off into the distance. He possesses distinct facial features with a prominent nose and curly hair that flows and appears voluminous. He is wearing period clothing consisting of a dark, textured garment and a large, pleated ruff around his neck. Around him, within the frame, are items associated with power or military leadership, including a helmet with an ornate design, a decorative sword, and a map labeled with "Armee des Princes" and "Armee Royale." The background is filled with detailed engravings of foliage and scrollwork, adding texture and depth to the image.

artworks.title: Calais Pier
artworks.artist: Francis Seymour Haden after Joseph Mallord William Turner
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 49.4 x 61.4 cm (19 7/16 x 24 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Fine and Larry Day in memory of Gaillard F. Ravenel
artworks.description: The image displays sailboats navigating through choppy waters. The horizon is high in the composition, framing the sails against the sky. The boats have intricate line work suggesting movement and texture of the sea. The style uses detailed lines akin to an etching technique, providing clarity and motion. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown, enhancing the atmosphere. In the distance, the water moves gently, giving depth to the scene.
